title: Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules which contain the Chlori
question: Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules which contain the Chlorine element.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN T1.molecule_id END) AS REAL) * 100 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom_molecule AS T1
WHERE T1.molecule_id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id
  FROM atom_molecule AS T2
  WHERE T2.label = '+'
)
